name: Ivern
notes: Friend of the Forest (P) only interacts with jungle camps, which do not exist in this fight, and never damages a champion, so it is not modeled at all.

Brushmaker (W) is cast once at the opening for its brush patch; it has a 0.25 s cast time (gen.W.castTimeS) that keeps Ivern busy before anything else can be cast or attacked, after which the patch lasts 45 seconds (far longer than the fight) and Ivern is assumed to stand inside it the whole time, so its on-hit magic bolt is treated as permanently active on every attack from then on.

Rootcaller (Q) is cast on cooldown for its upfront magic damage to the first enemy hit; it has a 0.25 s cast time (gen.Q.castTimeS) during which no other cast or attack starts. Its recast is a pure repositioning dash with no damage payload against a stationary target and is never used.

Triggerseed (E) has no cast time ("cast time = none" in the dossier, so gen.E.castTimeS is not modeled and no busy period is charged); it is cast on Ivern himself on cooldown and its explosion deals guaranteed magic damage 2 seconds after cast regardless of whether the shield holds, so the shield/heal component (irrelevant against a target that never attacks) is ignored.

Daisy! (R) is cast once at the opening to summon Daisy; it has a 0.5 s cast time (gen.R.castTimeS) that keeps Ivern busy before anything else, after which Daisy attacks the dummy for the rest of the fight on her own timer. Her recast is pure repositioning and is never used, matching the note that only the initial cast counts as an ability activation.

Daisy is modeled as a fully independent stat block: her attack damage scales only with Ivern's AP as given by the game files, and she does not inherit any of Ivern's items (attack speed, crit, on-hit effects, lifesteal), since no source documents such inheritance.

Daisy's baseline attack speed is not documented anywhere in the sources; a standard 0.625 attacks/second baseline is assumed and her rank bonus (IvernR.DaisyAS) is applied on top of it as a percentage bonus.

Every third consecutive attack Daisy lands on the dummy fires the Daisy Smash! shockwave for separate physical damage, per the ability's description; it is treated as a standalone damage instance, not an on-hit proc, since Daisy carries no on-hit effects to trigger.
Ivern attacks the dummy between casts to benefit from Brushmaker's on-hit bolt.
Mana is not modeled: none of Ivern's abilities are cast often enough in an 8-15 s fight at level 16 to plausibly run him out of mana.

assumed.why: Daisy's baseline attack speed before her rank bonus (IvernR.DaisyAS) is not stated in any wiki text or quote; assumed a standard 0.625 attacks/second baseline, since only her attack speed bonus by rank is present in the game files.
